searchText: I have drafted a decent proposal for 2 projects. Itching to talk to the mentors about my approach. I will link them as preliminary work in week0 dev update soon. I cannot contact with the mentors right now 🥲 due to program guidelines. I need to make sure the project is in a good state to start working on. Can i get feedback from the mentors on my initial draft? According to feedback, I will pick 1 project to work on. EthCC is about meeting people in person, all the research about projects is individual. The fellowship experience is the same for everyone even if you don't attend But everyone who is coming to Cannes at the time is invited to EPF Day, no matter whether they are fellow or not! You can reach out to me and ask for feedback or directions first. The current input from mentors is the list of project ideas, that's what you can build on
